details:
This update for proftpd fixes the following issues:

- Authenticated SFTP sessions can overflow the SFTP packet buffer (bsc#1271096).
- CVE-2026-35025: access control bypass allows authenticated FTP users to circumvent Directory ACL restrictions by
  prefixing paths with `/proc/self/root` in the RNFR command handler (bsc#1269065).
- CVE-2026-42167: `mod_sql` allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a username when there is logging of
  `USER` requests with an expansion such as `%U` and the SQL backend allows `comman` (bsc#1263183).
- CVE-2026-44331: SQL injection in `sqltab_fetch_clients_cb()` in `contrib/mod_wrap2_sql.c` triggered via crafted domain
  name from reverse DNS lookup (bsc#1264262).
- CVE-2026-53994: heap-based buffer overflow reachable by an authenticated SFTP user can lead to denial of service and
  memory corruption (bsc#1271946).
- CVE-2026-63090: heap-based buffer overflow in the `mod_sftp` module can lead to arbitrary code execution via crafted
  SFTP packet fragments (bsc#1271944).
- CVE-2026-63091: signed integer overflow in the `mod_sftp` module's SCP size-record parser can lead to ASLR bypass via
  a crafted file size value of `UINT64_MAX` (bsc#1271945).
- CVE-2026-119147: authorization bypass in the `mod_sftp` copy-file extension handler allows SFTP users to copy any
  readable file to a new path in write-denied directories (bsc#1289272).
- Integer overflow via client-provided file size for SCP uploads (bsc#1271097).
